messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High error rate detected on inference-hosting cluster 'inference-pool-3'. Symptoms: repeated container restarts (OOM) during prefill for long-context requests.

nina (oncall): Got the page, joining. Can someone paste the pod logs? I'll start a hotfix if needed.

leo (eng-runtime): I'm on it. Seeing this across multiple pods on node-gpu-12. Logs show CUDA OOM on prefill stage repeatedly.

sara (sre): Noted. I'm verifying node health and checking for node flaps. kubectl shows RestartCount spikes.

leo (eng-runtime): Log snippet:
```
E tensorflow/stream_executor/cuda/cuda_driver.cc:318] CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: out of memory
E runtime/inference/prefill.cc:142] Prefill failed: CUDA OOM when allocating 3.2GiB
I kubelet: Container runtime restarted container="redwood-infer-abc-123"
```

akash (eng-ml): Which model and config? Any recent rollout that increased context lengths?

leo (eng-runtime): Model: rdx-bert-xxl (quantized). Prefill tokens seen: 65k in some requests (users sending huge docs). This overwhelms the KV cache and GPU memory.

mike (cs): I'm seeing support tickets from 3 enterprise customers reporting 500 errors and high latency. One is on Dedicated. Marking customer-impact P1.

nina (oncall): Immediate mitigation proposals: 1) Route traffic away from inference-pool-3 to healthy pools. 2) Apply a temporary model-route to fallback rdx-bert-large (smaller). 3) Enforce per-request prefill token cap.

leo (eng-runtime): Doing a quick routing change now: `rdctl route set --pool=cold-infer --selector='model:rdx-bert-xxl' --percentage=0` (will divert to fallback). Running...

deploy-bot: Deploy started: routing-change-1890001234 by leo

leo (eng-runtime): Routing change applied. Rolling back heavy-model traffic from pool-3 -> fallback pool. Watch metrics.

sara (sre): I've cordoned node-gpu-12 to prevent new pods landing: `kubectl cordon node-gpu-12` and scaled down inference replica on that node.

akash (eng-ml): Also pushing a hotfix: server-side prefill guard to reject requests with prefill_tokens > 8k with a 413 and guidance to chunk the prompt. Sending PR.

leo (eng-runtime): Patch merged and deployed to edge: `PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=8192` env applied to runtime. Will take ~30s to propagate.

mike (cs): Messaging to affected customers: drafting template noting temporary routing to fallback model and asking for any critical prompts they can share.

nina (oncall): Handing off to akash (eng-ml) for longer-term fix and postmortem. My shift ends in 20m. Akash, please take ownership.

akash (eng-ml): Taking it. I'll triage root cause: why prefill tokens exploded (client-side bug? tokenizer mismatch?), and add telemetry to surface large prefill counts. I'll also add a grace-dropping prefill behavior instead of crash.

leo (eng-runtime): Also adding a safeguard: if prefill memory allocation would exceed 70% of GPU mem, we immediately fallback to CPU prefill or fallback model. Implementing circuit.

sara (sre): Node metrics stabilized after routing change. Restart rates down from 5/min to 0.2/min. No further node flaps. Marking system-stable for now.

mike (cs): Sent customer notifications to the 3 impacted accounts. Two acknowledged, one asked for timeline — I said ETA for full rollback/remediation is 6-12h.

akash (eng-ml): Follow-ups: postmortem, telemetry, add per-customer per-request prefill quotas, and an eval suite to replay large-context prompts. Will create tickets.

nina (oncall): Thanks team. I'll close the page once Akash confirms ownership and the postmortem ticket is created. :thumbsup:

akash (eng-ml): Created PM-18900: 'GPU OOM during prefill — rdx-bert-xxl' with action items. Will send postmortem draft by EOD.

leo (eng-runtime): Leaving a note: Consider adding automatic request shredding for >X tokens as a policy option for Dedicated customers.

nina (oncall): closing incident channel for now — monitoring. If anything reappears re-open the page. :eyes:
